# Sample three parametric coordinates

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

The t1 axis varies fastest in the FROG v1 flattened grid. Formulas \[t1,t2,t1+2*t2\] preserve the ordered coordinate triple at all four points.
